name: hard-run-after-heavy-legs
why: Ashley, 16 Nov 2026, 'Ahead and before': the coach weighs what was done in the last days as well as what is coming. Yesterday was a heavy leg session, closed in full; today is a rest day. Hard intervals today would be a second hard day on tired legs back to back. The answer must name yesterday's leg work and give the better option (easy or short, or another day), never a plain yes. A question, so no card.
